scope: User acceptance test of the deployed application. No model was retrained and no measured performance number was altered.
regression_suite: 111 passed, 0 failed (identical before and after the fixes)
demo_menu_caveat: The case menu is deliberately enriched for difficulty and this figure is NOT the model's accuracy, which remains 0.88583 on the held-out test partition.

bugs.title: Wrong drug's FDA label displayed as the dosage reference
bugs.detail: An unfielded openFDA full-text fallback accepted any returned label without checking it was the requested drug. Doripenem displayed LETERMOVIR (an antiviral), Ticarcillin displayed Ertapenem, and four combination agents displayed SILICEA, a homeopathic pellet. Six of 54 agents affected.
bugs.fix: FIX-01 - drug identity guard in 10_API_SERVICES/drug_api.py discards any label not naming the requested ingredient; mismatches 6 -> 0.

bugs.title: Combination antibiotics had neither dosage nor cost data
bugs.detail: The drug-name override table used hyphenated keys while the model vocabulary uses slashes, so ten combination agents missed the lookup. price_api reuses the same function, so NADAC cost failed identically.
bugs.fix: FIX-02 - separator-agnostic lookup plus four verified mappings in 10_API_SERVICES/drug_api.py.

bugs.title: Confidence band ignores evidence strength
bugs.detail: The band is computed from distance from 0.50 only, so an agent with zero training examples can read 'confidence: high' beside an evidence band of 'none - extrapolated'.
bugs.fix: Deferred - changes clinical presentation on every option card and should be a deliberate design decision.

bugs.title: Deprecated Streamlit use_container_width parameter
bugs.detail: Used in 20 places; scheduled for removal but still functional in the pinned version. Warning is never visible to users.
bugs.fix: Deferred - should be a standalone change before any Streamlit upgrade.

key_findings: The application explains its failures as readily as its successes: in the incorrect-prediction case the model was wrong on 6 of 8 agents and every disagreement was displayed with a working SHAP explanation.
Guardrails flag but never remove: agents with critical flags were demoted below unflagged options and remained visible with their reasons in all seven test cases.
Offline mode with the cache also neutralised produced 0 exceptions, all 9 tabs, and an intact prediction, with no traceback reaching the user.
The clinician review form refuses to record a decision without an explicit confirmation and a reviewer identifier.
SHAP accounts for 98.3% of ranking time while model inference for all 54 agents takes 66 ms - the documented slow first load is expected, not a defect.
manual_tests_required: Visual rendering: open the app in a browser and click through all 9 tabs plus the two pages, confirming the safety banner, charts, pills and layout render correctly.
Browser interactivity: switch to manual case entry, change the organism, and confirm every tab updates; tick 'history unknown' and confirm the assumed-fields notice.
Multi-organism cultures: load an order that grew more than one organism (e.g. 486309118) and confirm switching isolate changes the ground truth and ranking.
